F5: section 4 fuel form = forall fuel >= fuel0 + every called spec-fn resolved; EXP gains registry faithfulness; sound vs Denote.lean fuel-0-bottom=True. comments.content: DESIGN COMPLETE — the critique loop TERMINATED at cycle 7 with NO DIVERGENCE FOUND. Trajectory: 5/2/2/1/1/1/0 findings across 7 cycles (14 findings total, every one resolved + most kernel-pinned). The doc (.design/verified/proof-backends.md @ 78dcfe7f, ~1100 LOC): backend-neutral Obligations over the mechanized semantics via the STABILIZES relation (the per-env stabilized denotation — survived two false earlier forms, each disproved by a kernel-checked counterexample); the Engine trait with Verdict discipline (failure=Unknown never Refuted; the shipped fast-unknown seam remapped); trust profiles + per-obligation certificate attribution + the disagreement halt; the item-wide conjunction rule; the registry hard gate under the full-expression-position transitive closure (req∪ens∪body∪dec, step body∪dec — closed twice after #224/#226); REQ-1.2 registry termination; the three-tier export story (fuel-free auto / static unfolding / interactive stabilization); engine-generic mutation rules preserving the shipped #101 semantics; 4 pin files = 5 kernel-checked counterexamples wired as regression oracles. Build: increment (i) = #204 (open, the reified Obligation + Engine trait + the corrected closure mirror); increments (ii)-(iv) named. OQs deliberately open for co-authorship.
